Inside the control plane

The four core layers.

01Intelligent Control
Dynamic Access Governance
Decouple developer identity from brittle AWS IAM policies. Group engineers by business unit and assign model quotas in seconds.
Granular Model Allow-Listing
Guarantee that experimental or high-cost models (e.g. Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Opus) are restricted to authorized production workloads.
Proactive Budget Envelopes
Enforce hard monetary ceiling limits at the project, team, and agent level.
02Dynamic Optimization Engine
In-Memory Prompt Caching
Detect identical system prompts, schema definitions, and RAG document contexts across disparate users and serve them from low-cost cache layers.
Intelligent Fallback & Load Routing
Route around Bedrock region throttling or service outages without application-side downtime.
Automatic Batch Queuing
Ingest high-volume document summarization or batch processing tasks and execute them via Bedrock Batch Inference for an instant 50% discount.
03Request-Level Observability
Sub-Millisecond Telemetry
Capture token counts, prompt lengths, completion speeds, and cost metrics with zero added latency.
Guardrail Interception Tracking
Immediate alerts when prompts violate enterprise acceptable use, prompt injection defenses, or PII redaction rules.
Model Output Quality Assurance
Benchmark response consistency across model updates and parameter configurations.
04Continuous Reporting & Chargeback
Automated Monthly Showback/Chargeback
Clean, exportable accounting ledgers that Finance can feed directly into ERP systems like SAP or Workday.
Real-Time Savings Dashboard
Track dollar-for-dollar savings delivered by each of the 5 optimization pillars.
Audit-Ready Compliance Vault
Comprehensive documentation proving compliance with EU AI Act, HIPAA, SOC 2, and NIST AI Risk Management Frameworks.
